parameters.subject: AutoQuoter - Quote Request Received
parameters.emailBody:
={{ 'Hi ' + $node['Webhook Trigger'].data['name'] + ',

Thank you for your quote request for ' + $node['Webhook Trigger'].data['service'] + ' in ' + $node['Webhook Trigger'].data['city'] + ', ' + $node['Webhook Trigger'].data['state'] + '.

We've received your request and are processing it now. You'll receive your personalized quote within the next few minutes.

Quote Details:
- Service: ' + $node['Webhook Trigger'].data['service'] + '
- Location: ' + $node['Webhook Trigger'].data['city'] + ', ' + $node['Webhook Trigger'].data['state'] + ' ' + $node['Webhook Trigger'].data['zipcode'] + '
- Request ID: ' + $node['set-lead-id'].data['lead_id'] + '

Best regards,
The AutoQuoter Team' }}

parameters.subject: New Lead: {{ $node['Webhook Trigger'].data['service'] }} - {{ $node['Webhook Trigger'].data['city'] }}
parameters.emailBody:
={{ 'New quote request received!

Customer: ' + $node['Webhook Trigger'].data['name'] + '
Email: ' + $node['Webhook Trigger'].data['email'] + '
Service: ' + $node['Webhook Trigger'].data['service'] + '
Location: ' + $node['Webhook Trigger'].data['city'] + ', ' + $node['Webhook Trigger'].data['state'] + ' ' + $node['Webhook Trigger'].data['zipcode'] + '
Phone: ' + $node['Webhook Trigger'].data['phone'] + '

Lead ID: ' + $node['set-lead-id'].data['lead_id'] + '
Timestamp: ' + $node['set-lead-id'].data['timestamp'] + '

Please follow up within 15 minutes.' }}

parameters.subject: Your AutoQuoter Quote is Ready
parameters.emailBody:
={{ 'Hi ' + $node['Webhook Trigger'].data['name'] + ',

Your personalized quote is ready!

Quote Summary:
' + $node['generate-quote-api'].data['summary'] + '

Low Range: $' + $node['generate-quote-api'].data['low_range'] + '
Median Range: $' + $node['generate-quote-api'].data['median_range'] + '
High Range: $' + $node['generate-quote-api'].data['high_range'] + '

View full details and connect with contractors at: ' + $node['generate-quote-api'].data['quote_url'] + '

Questions? Reply to this email or call us.

Best regards,
The AutoQuoter Team' }}
